create.name: Joan Buckley
create.bio:
Joan Buckley is an Irish energy intuitive and angel healer based in Cork. She spent her early working life in the corporate world and turned towards spiritual practice in her thirties, training along the way as a Reiki Master, an Angel Energy Healing practitioner, a Master Instructor of Integrated Energy Therapy and a teacher of Louise Hay's philosophy. She has offered intuitive sessions, angel trainings, workshops and energetic work on land and buildings since 2007.

Her teaching sits within the angelic and New Earth strands of contemporary spirituality: guided meditations, activations and blessings that call on angels, elementals, dragons and star beings, often timed to moons, solstices and numerical gateways such as 11:11. In 2019 she set up Celestial Club, an online membership with live community calls, practices and an always-open meditative space. She also gives one-to-one intuitive and distance angel sessions, clears and blesses homes and event spaces, and runs short online gatherings through the year, with some held in person in Cork. Free meditations appear on Insight Timer and on her YouTube channel, where she posts regular short energy updates and light-language blessings.

courses.title: Celestial Club
courses.description: Her online membership, running since 2019, with live activations and guided meditations, community calls and a meditative online space that members can visit at any hour. Members also get a discount on one-to-one sessions.
courses.price: €33.33 EUR a month (as stated on the page)

courses.title: Intuitive Healing and Alignment
courses.description: A one-hour one-to-one session drawing on ancestral, akashic and past-life clearing and timeline work, guided by what she calls your spiritual team. A three-session series over three months is also offered.
courses.price: €188 EUR per session; €470 EUR for 3 sessions

courses.title: Distance Angel Healing
courses.description: A 45-minute remote session you receive while resting at home, with the angel messages she picks up sent to you by email afterwards.

courses.title: Sacred Space Creations
courses.description: Energetic clearing and blessing of a home, business or event venue, working with the guardians of the place and the angelic realms to set a supportive atmosphere for those who use it.

courses.title: 11:11: A Doorway to the Next Chapter
courses.description: A 45-minute online activation and meditation on 11 November 2026 at 11am, marking the 11:11 date as a gateway into 2027.

free_resources.title: Mini Angelic Retreat for Relaxation and Support
free_resources.description: A free downloadable guide that strings several of her free meditations into a home retreat of about one and a half to two and a half hours, to take in one sitting or across a few days.

free_resources.title: Archangel Michael Daily Energy Clearing
free_resources.description: A four-minute guided practice on Insight Timer for clearing your energy with Archangel Michael at the start or end of the day.

free_resources.title: Golden Light Chakra Cleanse For New Earth
free_resources.description: A sixteen-minute guided meditation on Insight Timer that moves golden light through each of the chakras.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube @joanbuckleylight 786 subscribers (channel header, 3 Nov 2026); Insight Timer follower count not shown on her profile (3 Nov 2026); Facebook not read (never fetched) → ~786 readable → local_hero
flags: Email is a support inbox (support@joanbuckley.com) published on her contact page alongside a form.
Base: her Insight Timer profile gives Cork, Ireland; her own site says events are online or 'in person in beautiful Cork, Ireland' but publishes no home town, so location_source is the hub profile.
Insight Timer follower count is not shown and Facebook was not fetched; tier rests on YouTube alone.

Health-claim borderline: her Distance Angel Healing page says it may 'support your health and wellbeing' and 'soothe and calm your nervous system', and the Celestial Club page mentions help with sleeping; item descriptions here avoid that wording, but a human may want to check those two pages.
Several of her Insight Timer tracks use 'healing' in the title (Archangel Raphael Healing Meditation, Angelic Healing...), with no named condition; I picked two tracks without it.
Her YouTube titles include energy updates on Comet 3I/ATLAS and 'galactic light'; New Age framing, not conspiracy content as far as I could see, but worth a glance.

Celestial Club price is inferred from the page's own wording ('saving you €33.33, the equivalent of the monthly Celestial Club cost'); the plans page currently shows 'No plans available' and there is a waitlist page, so the membership may be closed to new joiners.
Photos: YouTube avatar first, then two images from her own site (one with an edited room background); all clearly the same woman.
This lead was found after the queue was written (Insight Timer profile listed under Cork) and given rank 414.
left_out: Shop recordings such as 'Healing with Archangel Raphael', 'Nervous System Reset' and 'Angelic First Aid': health-framed titles.
Other shop event recordings: not opened one by one.
Free Distance Angel Healing on full and new moons: run through Facebook, which is never fetched.
Free Body Balance meditation: newsletter sign-up gift with body-health framing.
Guest interviews on other YouTube channels (Bs on a Mission, Gina Anayana): she is a guest, not the main teaching voice.
Short light-language blessings (under 2 minutes) and dated monthly energy updates on YouTube.
